title: Working on an early stage combined arms warfare game in Unity. Would anyone be interested in helping me test this in the future?
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
The game is fully functional. Currently I am in the process of overhauling the vehicles and making sure the player feels in charge.

A problem is that the battles are so enormous that you don't feel like you're affected change in the ultimate outcome. I have found a great way to remedy it that will be revealed later when it's really working.

comments.author: 21920alphabet
comments.body:
I am, I only ask that you test mine in return lol... Im yet to drop a playable version but here are some pictures:

https://i.redd.it/srvl198sm72i1.png

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: How cool! Is that a zero!?

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: So sick. I only know a few of these planes. Zero, Kate, etc. What are you running this on?

replies.author: 21920alphabet
replies.body:
Thanks. Here is the Zero! I'm doing it on godot. How about your game?

https://i.redd.it/zsffbo9du72i1.jpeg

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: Can you explain your game to me? I'd love to play it.

replies.author: 21920alphabet
replies.body: Sure I wanted a game that you fly with mouse like warthunder but with deep complete missions like IL2... so you fly pretty much like in war thunder but its not just a fast match, you have to take off, command wingman, perform escorts missions, bombing, torpedo bombing and return to base and land.

replies.author: 21920alphabet
replies.body: Yes and randomly generated missions. Once I get the AI brain working well and the generator logic fun I will add noeth africa east front and channel

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body:
Yes! North Africa always fascinated me. Have you ever looked into the scale of our naval fleet during those operations? How about Guadalcanal. 

The map you see me feature is Peleliu, but I am not using a WW2 time frame. Just thought it looked nice.

replies.author: 21920alphabet
replies.body:
To be honest the pacific is the theater I know less about, I just choose it first because: Lots of water = less pain creating terrain. 

About the naval fleet, so far I only gave the US one carrier, one destroyer, one support ship and one cruiser. Same for Japan plus one submarine. But they are all controlled by the AI, the player is just a pilot.

The graphics on your video are really good! how big is your map? and did you use blender to make the tank?

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body:
Absolutely but you can work around the terrain by adding mountains or something, simply being off limits.

Thanks, the map is the actual size of Peleliu!
